svg.title: Arndt Bohrenkämper: personal LCARS terminal
svg.desc: An independently designed fictional survey shuttle in a detailed three-quarter view. A sculpted metallic cabin with rounded shoulders, reflective three-pane cockpit glazing, recessed blue drive channels, service hatches and a forward sensor array sit within a dark exploration console. A visible star field surrounds the craft. Small status lights pulse slowly across several systems, with a few stars twinkling. Reduced-motion preferences disable all animation.
